要素の定義（config/interaction_pairs.yaml）：
- liquid_floor：liquid_floor_new phi = thresholds.phi_0 of abc_rules.yaml (1.0) for new capacity from 2026
- cold_subsidy：siting_subsidy_yen_per_kW (600,000 yen/kW of new IT nameplate) in Hokkaido and Tohoku from 2026
- uniform_subsidy：siting_subsidy_yen_per_kW in every non-metro region from 2026 (design A's s0)
- carbon_high：carbon_price path 'high' from 2026 (2024-2025 at the base value 0)
- reinforcement：conn_capacity_reinforced_GW_per_yr c1 from reinforcement_year T_g = 2030, reinforcement cost g = reinforcement_cost_yen_per_kW, theta = operator_burden_share
- ef_low：ef_national path 'low' (regional EF scaled as in the base)
- offgrid_re：ppa_tier2_premium_yen_per_kWh at its low end (1.0 instead of 3.0)

判定：Δ_M(S)＝M(∅)−M(S)、I_M＝Δ_M(X∪Y)−Δ_M(X)−Δ_M(Y)。前提（X→Y）：Δ_M(Y)≦ε かつ Δ_M(X∪Y)−Δ_M(X)＞ε（Y→X も確認）、増幅：I_M＞ε、代替：I_M＜−ε、ほかは独立。相反は別の印（X か Y の単独で M が ε を超えて悪化）。
